scope: Subagent contracts/store/sync/index/lazy-course targeted verification only; Phase 0–2. No commits or pushes. Results are structured summaries of actual completed runs, not reconstructed stdout. Root performs final integrated/offline/assembled-site/WebKit gates.
startupMeasurement: Cold local static-server Chromium with iPhone viewport and blocked service workers; source bytes exclude transfer compression and offline shell installation. Timings are diagnostic; physical-phone and hosted transfer performance are not established.
